name: DemoExportBlock
_comment: Standalone schema-v2 spec for the export chapter (Task 7). Not part of the pillow-block widget assembly -- a small, self-contained solid whose only job is to exercise the export: block (spec.md FR-1-03). Requires the schema_v2 feature flag ON at validate time; the CLI's --enable-flag does NOT reach the spec validator (spec/validator.py::_v2_enabled() re-resolves flags from the environment only), so the flag must be set via the AI_SW_BRIDGE_FLAG_SCHEMA_V2=1 environment variable (Spike E, 2026-08-08). See docs/demo_full_system.md.
